impact_scope.description: S1 replaces the VP8 placeholder with a public base.image_decoder implementation and its caller-driven image/frame decoding protocol.
S1 makes a WebP 'VP8 ' sub-chunk a supported lossy input and routes decoding through the embedded VP8 decoder; S0 rejected that format as unsupported.
S1 introduces the VP8 image-decoder call sequence and WebP delegation across image configuration, frame configuration, frame decoding, and restart.

evidence: In S0, std/vp8/decode_vp8.wuffs contains only a placeholder and exposes no VP8 decoder entry points or call-order protocol.
In S0, std/webp/decode_webp.wuffs rejects the 'VP8 ' lossy sub-chunk as '#unsupported WebP file', so no lossy-VP8 input path exists for H0 to expose.

gap_after.type: missing exposure of new VP8 decoding capability
evidence: In S1, std/vp8/decode_vp8.wuffs publicly implements base.image_decoder with image-config, frame-config, frame-decoding, and restart operations.
In S1, std/webp/decode_webp.wuffs accepts 'VP8 ' sub-chunks and delegates the image-decoder protocol to its embedded vp8.decoder.
H0 compiles only JSON-related modules and invokes only JSON decoding APIs, so it cannot construct or drive either the direct VP8 decoder or the new lossy-WebP route.

new_harness_obligation.description: A harness must enable and invoke the VP8/WebP image-decoder code, construct direct VP8 data or a WebP RIFF container containing a 'VP8 ' sub-chunk, and drive the image-config/frame-config/frame-decode call sequence with caller-supplied source and destination buffers.
evidence: The direct vp8.decoder public entry points did not exist in S0.
The WebP 'VP8 ' input construction was rejected in S0 but selects a new decoder path in S1.
H0 has no VP8 or WebP module enablement, image-decoder calls, pixel destination buffer, or image-decoder call-order transitions.

reason: For the stable scope of direct VP8 decoding and lossy VP8-in-WebP exposure, S0 had no exercisable capability and therefore no harness gap. S1 adds public decoder entries, a newly accepted WebP format path, and a caller-driven state protocol that the unchanged JSON-only H0 cannot reach. This creates a concrete new harness obligation, so the delta is NEW.
